summary: Support bounded ignore rules during first native bootstrap

delivery.outcome: Allow explicit exact-base trackability prerequisites during first native bootstrap while preserving every unrelated ignore rule and source ownership boundary.
nonGoals: No downstream application edits or hardware control
No ordinary upgrade ignore override, arbitrary source exceptions, or writer/publication grant

architecture.decision: Extend the existing immutable bootstrap planner with a bounded external exact-base/root-ignore digest plan. Append only exact currently ignored bootstrap payload leaves whose parent directories are already traversable. Recheck the plan and file bytes before effects; no general Git ignore rewrite.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert of standard; preserve target receipts and partial installer evidence.

validation.evidence: Real Git fixtures prove exact exceptions, refusal defaults, unchanged check-only and first canonical allocation.
Stale base/digest, unsafe plans, symlinks, parent exclusions and arbitrary source paths fail closed.
Managed governance, published package checks and independent exact-head verification.
